note: Recast from the redescription of S. longirostris by Bourguignon & Roisin (2011), the original in English; alate and soldier (both large and small) are described; the original lists S. dimorphus as a new synonym of this species, and its measurements are set alongside in square brackets.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head with 10—15 setae; compound eyes medium-sized; pronotum with about 50 setae, mainly on the margins; antenna 20 segments. Measurements (mm, 6 individuals from 1 colony): body length 7.39—8.79; head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.37—1.58; head width (including eyes) 1.51—1.62; pronotum length 0.73—0.79; pronotum width 1.23—1.36; forewing length 8.70—9.80; eye major diameter 0.31—0.33.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text:
Large soldier: body small. Head (excluding the labrum) subquadrate, slightly longer than wide, with about 10 setae; labrum slightly longer than wide, reaching the mandibular tips; antenna 15 or 16 segments; pronotum with 6 long setae at each corner; mesonotum and metanotum with 4 each; abdomen with 6 long setae per segment, occasionally with 1—2 shorter ones added; mandibular tips strongly curved, marginal teeth short; left mandible with 2 equal marginal teeth; right mandible without a basal boss. Measurements (mm, 1 individual from the type colony of this species; in square brackets 2 individuals from the type colony of S. dimorphus; in parentheses 77 individuals from 29 colonies): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 1.56 [1.50—1.56] (1.35—1.95); head length to the labral tip 2.05 [1.92—1.99] (1.65—2.21); maximum head width 1.32 [1.31—1.35] (1.17—1.51); pronotum width 0.74 [0.73—0.75] (0.65—0.86); right mandible length 0.98 [0.89—0.97] (0.75—1.06); minimum postmentum width 0.25 [0.24] (0.19—0.30); hind tibia length 1.19 [1.09—1.16] (1.11—1.36).

Small soldier: body small. Head elongate, with 5—10 setae; labrum very long, 3 times its width, extending beyond the mandibular tips; postclypeus medium-sized; antenna 15 or 16 segments; pronotum with 6 long setae at each corner; meso- and metanotum with 4 each; abdomen with 6 long setae per segment, occasionally with 1—2 shorter ones added; mandibles slender, almost straight, marginal teeth short. Measurements (mm, 10 individuals from 10 colonies; in square brackets 6 individuals from the type colony of S. dimorphus): head length to the anterior margin of the postclypeus 0.82—1.05 [0.90—0.94]; head length to the labral tip 1.18—1.54 [1.30—1.37]; maximum head width 0.60—0.77 [0.66—0.69]; pronotum length 0.28—0.36 [0.30—0.33]; pronotum width 0.40—0.53 [0.44—0.51]; right mandible length 0.52—0.70 [0.51—0.64]; maximum postmentum width 0.25—0.31 [0.24—0.28]; hind tibia length 0.74—0.94 [0.71—0.87].

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: It differs from the other New Guinea species by the setal counts of the large soldier on the pronotum (6 per corner), the mesonotum (4) and the metanotum (4), and the abdomen (6 per segment). The original treats S. dimorphus (Desneux, 1905) as a new synonym of this species, and the measurements of its type specimens are set alongside in square brackets.
